registrationBody.description: e.g. Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria

isUpdate.description: A newer version of an already-published mission

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt from your last read (optimistic concurrency)

reReviewPending.description: Published missions with an edited version not yet re-approved (edits never change approved content)

active.description: Verified clinicians who hold the reviewer role

publishedWithoutReferences.description: Published missions whose approved version cites no clinical reference

status.description: applied: processed now · duplicate: already processed (stored result returned) · stale: superseded by a newer change · rejected: not applicable (see code)

data.description: Outcome (e.g. answer reveal, attempt id, shift result)

versionNumber.description: Mission pack version played offline; rejected with CONFLICT (mission_changed) if outdated

attempts.description: In-progress attempts plus attempts changed since `since`

guestAccessToken.description: Access token of the guest session being merged

expectedVersion.description: Active version you edited; 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED if it changed meanwhile

activePlayers.description: Distinct users with a session used in the 1/7/30 days before `to`

guestConversions.description: Guests who registered (upgrade or merge) in the period

choiceDistribution.description: How often each option was chosen (helps clinicians spot confusing steps)

confirmEmail.description: Must match the account's email (guards against wrong-target deletes)

correct.description: From the recorded attempt, never from the model

strengths.description: Empty for debriefs generated before prompt v2

topic.description: A topic of the approved case catalogue

missions.description: Approved cases on this topic the learner can open

recommendedTopics.description: Chosen by the model only from topics of clinician-approved cases

aiGenerated.description: Always true: this is AI-generated educational feedback, labelled as such in every client

regenerate.description: Generate a new debrief even if one exists for this level

enabled.description: False when AI is switched off, not configured, or the monthly budget is used

rateLimited.description: Provider calls rejected by Anthropic's rate limits

keyConfigured.description: Whether the server has an API key (the key itself is never returned)

post.summary: Upload queued offline events (applied in order, each at most once)
post.description:
Each event carries a device-generated `eventId` (UUID); re-sending an event returns its stored result with status `duplicate`.

Events in one batch can refer to an attempt started earlier in the queue as `client:<clientRef>`.

Conflicts: the server is authoritative. The first answer to a step wins (same choice → `duplicate`, different choice → `rejected` with the current attempt). Profile edits are last-writer-wins by device time (`stale` when superseded). Funding is checked when the event is processed (`rejected` with `INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS`).

Device timestamps more than 5 minutes in the future are clamped to server time. Clients can never send HP, funding, completion or unlocks.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header; retries with the same key replay the first response.

401.description: Not signed in or session ended (UNAUTHENTICATED)

post.summary: Request a learning debrief for a completed attempt (Anthropic Claude, server-side)
post.description:
Built from the server-recorded attempt and the clinician-approved case; correctness verdicts are copied from the attempt, never from the model, and only the version's approved references can be cited.

`201` new debrief generated; `200` existing debrief for this level (pass `regenerate: true` for a new one); `202` still generating after 25 s — poll `GET /debriefs/{id}`.

A failed generation (`status: failed`) does not count against the daily quota.

`409 CONFLICT` (detail `mission: not_approved`) when the attempt's case version is not clinician-approved (withdrawn or retired).

The debrief is AI-generated educational feedback (`aiGenerated: true`) and must be labelled so; it never replaces clinical instruction.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header; retries with the same key replay the first response.

The provider is set by server configuration (`AI_PROVIDER`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`); the key is never returned. Change the model, effort, fallback model and limits via `PUT /admin/settings/ai`.

**Permission:** `settings:read`.

**Staff MFA** must be verified in this session.

401.description: Not signed in or session ended (UNAUTHENTICATED)

get.summary: Download an offline mission pack (offline-eligible published missions; no answer keys)
get.description: Contains the story and every step's prompt and choices, but never correct answers, feedback or critical flags. Play it offline, queue `attempt.start` (with `versionNumber`) and `attempt.answer` events, and the server scores them when the device syncs (`POST /sync/events`). An outdated pack is rejected with `CONFLICT` (`mission_changed`).
